en: The Dyad on Taints, the Triad on the Wholesome.

Dependent on a state that is neither an *āsava* nor wholesome, a state that is neither an *āsava* nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is an *āsava* and unwholesome, a state that is neither an *āsava* nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition … Under the root condition: three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: three.

Dependent on a state that is neither an *āsava* nor indeterminate, a state that is neither an *āsava* nor indeterminate arises by way of the root condition … Under the root condition: three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: three.
